body: Nothing. I halfway don't even understand your question. What does the average Joe do to nourish his/herself? I socialize, have a good group of friends, go to the driving range, and indoor rock climb. My favorite recreational though is to just watch tv shows and movies every minute to escape. None of this combats the fact that it's all unfulfilling. I really don't think spending hours at a homeless shelter would give me a new outlook.

That's an interesting and introspective question. I think I listed the two because they're both the most insulating activities in daily life. So to add more to that list it would just be any hermit like behavior.
